positions.name: FieldLabelAttribution
positions.frame: When the calibration facts are carried forward as structured field-labels rather than as the speaker's own words, whose authority stands behind the restated claim?
positions.why: Both expressions take the calibration facts Quill Ashgrove asserted directly (src-1) and recast them as flat field-label entries under a single shared footing case (fc-1): animator and author fixed to Xena ExpertGH, principal left null. That shared footing structure — not merely the shared register — is what ties these two together into one directional read: they pose the same open question about who is answerable for the restated fact once it leaves the original speaker's mouth and enters the structured record. src-1 is excluded because it carries its own direct attribution (Quill as speaker) and needs no such question asked of it.
